discoveries.title: A Flag Above Royal Street

hints.text: Start on Royal Street and look above the storefront level rather than at the signs in front of you.
Search the roofline for a flag connected to the real-world state that inspired this land.
The detail is the Louisiana state flag flying above Royal Street.

discoveries.revealDescription: Look above Royal Street for the Louisiana state flag, a small real-world touch that reinforces New Orleans Square's setting.

discoveries.title: Four Streets in One Tiny Land

hints.text: Ignore attraction names and hunt for the land's own street signs.
One sign can help you notice that New Orleans Square is laid out like a miniature city neighborhood.
Find the named streets: Royal Street, Orleans Street, Front Street, and Esplanade Street.

discoveries.revealDescription: New Orleans Square uses actual street names—Royal, Orleans, Front, and Esplanade—rather than treating every walkway as an unnamed path.

discoveries.title: The 21 Royal Address

hints.text: Most Disneyland buildings do not advertise a normal-looking street number. Look for one here.
Stay around Royal Street and scan doors and façades for a two-digit address.
Find the building marked 21 Royal Street.

discoveries.revealDescription: The detail is the 21 Royal Street address—one of the unusually specific street addresses built into New Orleans Square.

discoveries.title: The 33 Orleans Address

hints.text: Another numbered address is nearby, but this one is associated with a famously private Disneyland space.
Look around Orleans Street for the number rather than searching the old Royal Street entrance.
Find the entrance marked 33 Orleans Street.

discoveries.revealDescription: The current Club 33 entrance is associated with 33 Orleans Street, a discreet numbered address tucked into New Orleans Square.

discoveries.title: Two Initials in the Ironwork

hints.text: Stand outside near Pirates of the Caribbean and look up toward the balcony ironwork.
Do not search for a printed sign. The tribute is worked into the decorative railing itself.
Look for the initials WD and RD hidden in the balcony railing above the Pirates area.

discoveries.revealDescription: The balcony railing includes WD and RD, honoring Walt Disney and Roy Disney in the space originally planned as a private family apartment.

discoveries.title: The Mysterious 1764

hints.text: Walk the New Orleans Square side of the Rivers of America and inspect the themed masonry.
You're looking for a four-digit year worked into a bricked-up architectural detail.
Find the sealed-looking wall detail marked 1764 along the riverfront.

discoveries.revealDescription: The riverfront detail is marked 1764, an atmospheric reference tied to the history and architectural influences of New Orleans.

discoveries.title: A Tiny Pirate in the Window

hints.text: After the Pirates area, inspect the display windows at Pieces of Eight instead of walking straight past.
Look for a small figure styled like a familiar movie pirate rather than a full-size prop.
The target is the Captain Jack Sparrow-style voodoo doll in the Pieces of Eight window.

discoveries.revealDescription: A small Captain Jack Sparrow-style voodoo doll is hidden among the Pieces of Eight display details.

discoveries.title: The Monkey Above the Register

hints.text: Inside Pieces of Eight, shift your attention from the merchandise to the ceiling fixtures.
Search above the register for an animal worked into a chandelier.
Find the white pirate monkey hanging from the chandelier above the register area.

discoveries.revealDescription: A white pirate monkey hangs from a chandelier above the register area, echoing the mischievous monkey associated with the Pirates films.

discoveries.title: The Ship You Cannot Reach

hints.text: Look above the New Orleans Square roofs and pretend you are standing in a busy port.
The ship is not on the river in front of you. Only part of it appears above the buildings.
Find the sailing-ship masts and sails peeking over the New Orleans Square roofline.

discoveries.revealDescription: The rooftop masts and sails create the illusion that a tall ship is docked just beyond the buildings, extending the port-city story beyond the visible streets.

discoveries.title: The Fountain With a Past

hints.text: Enter the newer Haunted Mansion grounds and watch for a familiar water feature near the start of the expanded queue.
It is a Spanish-style fountain that was reused rather than created only for this garden.
Find the Spanish fountain near the entrance to the expanded Haunted Mansion grounds.

discoveries.revealDescription: The Spanish-style fountain in the expanded Haunted Mansion queue previously stood in the nearby area that became Magnolia Park.

discoveries.title: Two Ravens on Watch

hints.text: Once inside the expanded Mansion grounds, look for a matched pair acting like silent guards.
They are birds with a long association with omens and the supernatural.
Find the pair of raven figures guarding the Haunted Mansion garden path.

discoveries.revealDescription: Two raven figures guard the expanded grounds, adding an ominous bridge between the living world and the Mansion's ghostly story.

discoveries.title: The Cat Ready to Pounce

hints.text: Search low instead of high as you move through the Haunted Mansion garden.
The figure is tucked among grasses and looks frozen just before a leap.
Find the crouching cat statue hidden among the grasses in the queue garden.

discoveries.revealDescription: A crouching cat statue sits low among the grasses, posed as if it is about to pounce.

discoveries.title: The Storm-Tossed Sea Maiden

hints.text: Look for the garden space associated with Master Gracey.
Inspect the fountain face rather than only the water or surrounding plants.
Find the sea-maiden face in Master Gracey's garden fountain, with wild hair and a startled expression.

discoveries.revealDescription: Master Gracey's garden includes a fountain with the face of a sea maiden whose windswept hair and startled expression make her look caught in a storm.

discoveries.title: What Gracey Left Behind

hints.text: Stay in Master Gracey's garden and inspect the old iron gazebo.
You're looking for a small group of personal objects, as if someone stood up and walked away.
Find the bench with a well-read book, an armillary sphere, and a pipe left in the gazebo.

discoveries.revealDescription: Inside Master Gracey's wrought-iron gazebo are a bench, a worn book, an armillary sphere, and a pipe—quiet props that make the garden feel recently occupied.

discoveries.title: Leota's Frozen Oddities

hints.text: Move farther into the grounds toward Madame Leota's garden and scan the small statuary.
Look for several little animals that seem caught in the middle of an enchantment.
Find the oddity statues—including frogs, lizards, rats, and a cymbal-playing monkey.

discoveries.revealDescription: Madame Leota's garden contains a collection of strange little animal statues, including a cymbal-playing monkey, all posed as if frozen by a spell.

discoveries.title: A Garden Full of Fortunes

hints.text: Madame Leota's garden repeats one shape often enough to become a visual theme.
Think of the object a fortune teller might stare into for a glimpse of the future.
Look for the repeating crystal-ball or fortune-telling orb motif throughout Leota's garden.

discoveries.revealDescription: Fortune-telling orbs repeat throughout Madame Leota's garden, visually linking the space to her role as the Mansion's resident medium.

discoveries.title: The Tree That Rings

hints.text: Find the large oak in Madame Leota's courtyard and look beyond its leaves.
This detail can move and make sound when the breeze catches it.
Look for the colorful ornaments, chimes, and bells hanging from the oak tree.

discoveries.revealDescription: Madame Leota's courtyard oak is decorated with colorful ornaments, chimes, and bells that can stir and ring in the breeze.

discoveries.title: The Ghosts' Greenhouse

hints.text: Keep moving toward the rear of the expanded Haunted Mansion garden.
Look for an ornate structure made from iron and glass rather than another statue.
Find the Mansion greenhouse at the back of the garden and inspect its unusual plant collection.

discoveries.revealDescription: At the rear of the grounds is an ornate iron-and-glass greenhouse presented as a place where the Mansion's ghostly residents cultivate unusual plants.
